summary: Everyone knows these songs, but nearly every famous hit outside the top 10 (Despacito, Old Town Road, Bad Guy, Dance Monkey) costs a life, so most players run out with about 4 found. Great as a Blitz, too punishing for a daily.
reasons: Casual found 7 and was out of lives at guess 12 (Dance Monkey #34, Despacito, Bad Guy #83, Old Town Road, Believer #16). That took a lucky order: 4,000 fame-weighted casual orders averaged about 4 found, and 6 to 8 in about one game in five.

The ranking rewards songs people replay for years (Sweater Weather #3, Perfect, Stay), so each year's biggest hit is a wrong guess. Die with a Smile #11 is a fun near miss; Uptown Funk #96 and Flowers #80 just cost a life.
Fan swept 10/10 with no misses. Casual Blitz scored 17 of 22, since the whole top 100 scores.
fixes: Guesses with the artist are told 'not on the list': 'stay justin bieber', 'perfect ed sheeran', 'shape of you ed sheeran', 'starboy the weeknd'. Already queued as the matcher 'title artist' item.
Add aliases 'Sweet Child of Mine' (Sweet Child O' Mine, #88) and 'Seven Rings' (7 Rings, #87); neither is recognized.

Refresh the page before this list is ever scheduled: #10 Stay (4.120B) leads #11 Die with a Smile (4.101B) by 19M streams, with I Wanna Be Yours and Birds of a Feather within 50M (page cached 2026-10-29).
